Your Personal Information

To start, your personal information is any information that can identify somebody, which might include:
- Personally identifiable information (PII) such as credit card numbers and other financial information, social insurance numbers, name, date, place of birth, and so on;
- Biometric information, such as fingerprints and facial recognition; and
- Private information, such as race, religion, sexual orientation, and physical and mental health.
